payload.description_html: Members of the Sino-Canadian Paleontological Expedition to Gobi Desert exposing skeletons of the juvenile dinosaurs (Pinacosaurus) in Bayanmanduhu locality (A). In the inset (B) a skull of one of the 'baby' dinosaurs is shown. The compass visible in the upper left corner of the photographs is placed on the foreset of an ancient eolian dune that buried the animals.
